description: Flat per-sample metadata schema for 16S rRNA sequencing of microbial communities from coral reef ecosystems in the Great Barrier Reef, including spatial, environmental, and sequencing-context fields.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for each sample record. Should be stable and non-reused across the dataset (e.g., CRR001_001).

study_id.descr: Identifier for the parent study or project, useful when combining multiple sampling campaigns or subprojects.

collection_date.descr: Date when the sample was collected from the field, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

collection_time.descr: Local time of sample collection, if available, in 24-hour format (HH:MM:SS).

site_name.descr: Name of the reef site or sampling location within the Great Barrier Reef.

site_code.descr: Short code or abbreviation for the sampling site, if used in field notes or lab records.

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

depth_m.descr: Water depth at which the sample was collected, in meters (m).

reef_zone.descr: Reef habitat or zone category at the sampling point, such as crest, slope, lagoon, back reef, fore reef, or patch reef.

habitat_type.descr: Fine-scale habitat description, such as coral surface, mucus layer, surrounding seawater, sediment, rubble, or benthic boundary layer.

host_coral_species.descr: Scientific name of the coral host, if the sample is associated with a coral colony; otherwise use 'none' or 'NA'.

host_health_status.descr: Observed coral health state at sampling, such as healthy, bleached, diseased, stressed, or unknown.

sample_material.descr: Material sequenced, such as seawater, coral tissue, coral mucus, skeleton surface, sediment, or biofilm.

sample_volume_l.descr: Volume of seawater filtered or collected for the sample, in liters (L), if applicable.

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size used to capture microorganisms, in micrometers (µm), if applicable.

replicate_number.descr: Biological or field replicate number for the sampling unit, starting at 1.

collection_method.descr: Method used to obtain the sample, such as diver collection, syringe, filtration, swab, core, or grab sample.

preservation_method.descr: Method used to preserve the sample after collection, such as flash freezing, RNAlater, ethanol, dry ice, or immediate extraction.

extraction_protocol.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol used, including kit name and version where possible.

amplicon_target_region.descr: 16S rRNA gene region amplified, such as V3-V4, V4, or V4-V5.

forward_primer_sequence.descr: Forward primer sequence used for PCR amplification, written 5' to 3'.

reverse_primer_sequence.descr: Reverse primer sequence used for PCR amplification, written 5' to 3'.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument or platform, such as Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, or HiSeq.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs (bp), per read if known.

run_id.descr: Sequencing run or lane identifier associated with the sample, if available.

barcode_sequence.descr: Sample barcode or index sequence used for demultiplexing, if applicable.

water_temperature_c.descr: In situ water temperature at the sampling site, in degrees Celsius (°C).

ph.descr: Measured pH of seawater at the sampling site, on the standard pH scale.

salinity_psu.descr: Salinity at the sampling site, in practical salinity units (PSU).

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration in seawater, in milligrams per liter (mg/L), if measured.

nitrate_umol_l.descr: Nitrate concentration in seawater, in micromoles per liter (µmol/L), if measured.

nitrite_umol_l.descr: Nitrite concentration in seawater, in micromoles per liter (µmol/L), if measured.

ammonium_umol_l.descr: Ammonium concentration in seawater, in micromoles per liter (µmol/L), if measured.

phosphate_umol_l.descr: Phosphate concentration in seawater, in micromoles per liter (µmol/L), if measured.

chlorophyll_a_ug_l.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration in seawater, in micrograms per liter (µg/L), if measured.

turbidity_ntu.descr: Water turbidity at the sampling site, in nephelometric turbidity units (NTU), if measured.

current_speed_ms.descr: Local current speed at the sampling point, in meters per second (m/s), if measured.

light_intensity_umol_m2_s.descr: Photosynthetically active radiation (PAR) or light intensity at the sampling site, in µmol photons m^-2 s^-1, if measured.

wave_exposure.descr: Relative wave exposure category at the site, such as low, moderate, or high.

sea_surface_temperature_c.descr: Sea surface temperature near the sampling site, in degrees Celsius (°C), if available.

season.descr: Sampling season or campaign period, such as summer, autumn, winter, spring, wet season, or dry season.

weather_conditions.descr: Brief description of weather conditions during sampling, such as calm, cloudy, rainy, windy, or mixed.

tide_state.descr: Tidal state during sampling, such as low tide, high tide, rising, falling, or unknown.

distance_to_shore_km.descr: Approximate distance from the sampling site to the nearest shoreline, in kilometers (km), if applicable.

coral_cover_percent.descr: Percent coral cover at or near the sampling site, if assessed.

macroalgal_cover_percent.descr: Percent macroalgal cover at or near the sampling site, if assessed.

symbiont_present.descr: Whether eukaryotic algal symbionts or other target symbionts were observed in the sample context; use true or false.

technical_replicate.descr: Indicates whether the record corresponds to a technical replicate from the same biological sample.

dna_concentration_ng_ul.descr: DNA concentration after extraction, in nanograms per microliter (ng/µL), if measured.

dna_quality_ratio.descr: DNA purity metric such as A260/280 or A260/230; specify the metric in accompanying lab notes if needed.

pcr_cycles.descr: Number of PCR amplification cycles used for 16S library preparation.

library_pool_id.descr: Identifier for the pooled sequencing library or batch, if applicable.

sequencing_center.descr: Facility or laboratory where sequencing was performed.

bioinformatics_pipeline.descr: Primary analysis pipeline or workflow used for sequence processing, such as QIIME2, DADA2, mothur, or USEARCH.

reference_database.descr: Taxonomic reference database used for classification, such as SILVA, Greengenes, or RDP, including version if known.

otu_asv_method.descr: Method used to generate sequence features, such as ASV inference or OTU clustering.

taxonomic_assignment_confidence.descr: Confidence threshold or score used for taxonomic assignment, if recorded.

notes.descr: Free-text field for additional relevant observations, anomalies, or contextual information not captured elsewhere.
